note: Manual audit of every skill the deterministic front end refutes in its HOME runtime (profile claude-ai). Each entry records whether the refutation is GENUINE (the document really instructs the agent to call a tool no runtime in our set provides, typically an MCP server tool) or a MISEXTRACTION (the front end read a code identifier -- a method, a settings key, a crate, an HTML meta tag, a CLI name -- as an agent tool). Line numbers are file lines. Judged by reading the cited line in context.
